entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Sales', 'Support', or 'Returns' to be connected to the right department.
Connecting you to an agent now.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex. I need to start a return for an order I placed a little while ago. It's a cycling jersey.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?

Great, thank you. Pulling that up now... I see the Pro-Vent jersey in blue, delivered about 57 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the jersey, or more of a preference issue with the fit?
It's definitely a fit issue. I ordered my usual size, but it's the wrong size for me. It's just way too tight across the shoulders. I'd like to do an exchange for the next size up if possible.
Understood. Thanks for clarifying that. Let me just double-check our return policy for you.
Okay, I've confirmed it. Since the jersey was delivered 57 days ago, it's still well within our 90-day return window for standard apparel. We can absolutely process that exchange for you.

That's great news. I appreciate that. Now, since I have to go through the process of packaging this one up and sending it back, is there any chance you could offer a small discount code for my trouble? I'm probably going to buy some matching shorts later this month.

I understand the request. While I can't offer a discount code, I can assure you the exchange process is straightforward and we'll cover the return shipping for you. I'm generating a prepaid shipping label that I'll email to you right after this call. Is the email on file still correct?
Alright, that's fair enough. Yes, the email is correct. So you'll send the label and I just send the too tight jersey back, and you'll ship the new one?

That's exactly right. As soon as the tracking on the return label shows it's in transit, our system will automatically release the new size for shipment. You should have it within 3-5 business days after you drop the return off. Is there anything else I can help with today?
No, that covers it. Thank you for your help, Alex.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
